description: This Java source file defines the ExternalBlockStoreClient class, which manages network communication for reading and writing shuffle and RDD blocks to an external shuffle server in Apache Spark. It includes methods for fetching, pushing, finalizing shuffle merges, retrieving merged block metadata, removing shuffle merges, registering with shuffle servers, and removing blocks.

classes.name: ExternalBlockStoreClient
classes.description: Manages network interactions for fetching, pushing, and managing shuffle and RDD blocks with an external shuffle server in Spark.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the client with the application ID and sets up the transport context and client factory.

methods.name: setAppAttemptId
methods.description: Sets the application attempt ID and updates the comparableAppAttemptId for shuffle identification.

methods.name: fetchBlocks
methods.description: Fetches specified blocks from a remote host and port, with retries and callback handling.

methods.name: pushBlocks
methods.description: Pushes blocks to a remote host and port, with retries and callback handling.

methods.name: finalizeShuffleMerge
methods.description: Sends a request to finalize a shuffle merge on the remote server.

methods.name: getMergedBlockMeta
methods.description: Retrieves metadata for merged blocks for a specific shuffle and reduce ID.

methods.name: removeShuffleMerge
methods.description: Removes a shuffle merge from the external shuffle service.

methods.name: shuffleMetrics
methods.description: Returns metrics related to shuffle operations.

methods.name: registerWithShuffleServer
methods.description: Registers the executor with the external shuffle server, providing shuffle file info.

methods.name: removeBlocks
methods.description: Removes specified blocks from the external shuffle service asynchronously.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the client and releases resources.
